items.name: Sakura's Vengeance
items.generation_prompt: 16x16 pixel art elegant Japanese katana sword, pink and crimson blade with cherry blossom petals, curved elegant design, glowing pink sakura energy, dark fantasy RPG weapon item sprite, transparent background
items.description: A legendary katana forged from the heartwood of an ancient cherry tree. Each kill sends a flurry of sakura petals, granting +10 SPD and +5 DEX for 3 seconds.
